I like this, but I feel the addendum has aged poorly.

It might be more interesting if there were testing logs instead. Like, suppose they took him to an Italian restaurant: would he be more likely to regurgitate Italian food? Suppose he played someone else in pool: would he be trying to get all of his balls out of the pockets instead of into them? And what about his footprints and fingerprints?

Also it would be nice to see him forced to attempt healing someone by stabbing them in reverse, and the inevitable mental trauma that entails.
